english.title: Person convicted of an offence still fail comply with notice to maintain land - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been convicted of an offence under section 216(2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF CONVICTION..), did not as soon as practicable do everything in your power to secure compliance with the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 216(6) and (6A) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

english.notes: This offence should be used in relation to offences committed from the 25th April 2024 due to changes in penalty made by section 20 of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023. For the equivalent offence applicable to England, see H101656.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding one-tenth of level 3 on the standard scale for every day following the first conviction on which any of the requirements of the notice remain unfulfilled.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
